$comment: CSP NOTES -- read before editing.
This is the SINGLE source of the Content-Security-Policy. `kit.csp` in
svelte.config.js was also set (mode: 'auto'), which emitted a SECOND,
independent CSP header. Browsers enforce multiple CSP headers as an
INTERSECTION, so the effective policy was the overlap of the two -- and
SvelteKit's auto mode adds hashes/nonces, which per spec causes browsers to
IGNORE 'unsafe-inline' in that same directive. That would have blocked the
hand-written inline theme script in src/app.html. kit.csp is now removed.
img-src deliberately allows any https: origin. Article bodies are authored
in Notion and can embed images from anywhere; an allowlist would silently
break editorial content. http: is still excluded, so no mixed content.
'unsafe-inline' in script-src is required by the theme bootstrap in
app.html, which SvelteKit does not hash (it only handles scripts it injects
itself). Removing it means moving that script under SvelteKit's control or
hashing it by hand -- worth doing later, not before launch.
Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights are first-party proxied on Vercel
(/_vercel/insights/*, /_vercel/speed-insights/*), so 'self' covers them in
production. va.vercel-scripts.com is listed because the dev/debug build of
the script loads from there, and vitals.vercel-insights.com is the beacon
endpoint some versions still use.
There are no third-party analytics origins here on purpose. The inherited
Google Analytics tag was removed in Sep 2026 (see user/config/site.ts). If
the Tech ever adds GA with its own measurement ID, script-src needs
https://www.googletagmanager.com and connect-src needs
https://www.google-analytics.com.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://va.vercel-scripts.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' https:; connect-src 'self' https://xguzskbxiptvhbyggkpl.supabase.co https://va.vercel-scripts.com https://vitals.vercel-insights.com; frame-src https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'
